fields.summary_ko.0: Seagate Technology (STX) fell 15% last week, but Morgan Stanley's Erik Woodring maintained an Overweight rating and $1,148 price target, suggesting potential for a doubling within 12 months.
fields.summary_ko.1: Fiscal Q1 (ended October 2) revenue increased 61% to $423 million, with adjusted EPS of $7.68, and guidance for December quarter revenue of $480 million, while achieving record quarterly operating cash flow of $150 million.
fields.summary_ko.2: Forward P/E ratio is 9.8x, significantly lower than the 5-year average of 26x, with Morgan Stanley's price target at current levels equating to approximately 24x forward earnings, still below average.
